correctness.rationale: The pinned resolvent gives f(s)=k/(k+sqrt(v^2+4Ds)) exp((v-sqrt(v^2+4Ds))L/(2D)); the renewal objective is (1-f(r))/(r f(r)). With y=sqrt(b^2+rL^2/D)-b, derivative numerator N/y^2 has a negative singular part and strictly positive higher Taylor coefficients. This proves a unique finite-a optimum; root bracketing of N gives the fixed-b and lambda a^(-1/3) limits. Independently verified the reparameterization to the published prior exact constants and cubic. Numerical sampled diagnostics in pinned verify.py cannot prove uniform convergence; the written local-uniform expansion and monotonic roots supply it.
